name: Samophlange
summary: At a Venture Company outpost in the northern Barrens, Sputtervalve seeks a device called a samophlange. He sends you southwest of the Sludge Fen to find it.

sections.title: A Peculiar Contraption
sections.body: In the northern Barrens, Sputtervalve cannot say what the Venture Company is building. The goblin engineer and tinker works in Ratchet, while the rival company experiments southwest of the Sludge Fen. Its workers call one device a samophlange. Sputtervalve knows neither its purpose nor its value, but wants to study its design before his competitors profit from it.

sections.title: Infiltrating the Rig
sections.body: Armed overseers, deforesters, and machinery guard the Venture Company research site. Sputtervalve gives you an intercepted operating manual to help shut down the rig safely. At the central control station, you find a locked console fitted with levers, lights, and gauges. Three control valves keep the rig's pressure in order.

faq.answer: Sputtervalve does not know exactly what the samophlange is or does. The Venture Company made it as an experimental mechanical component at its site southwest of the Sludge Fen.
Sputtervalve is a goblin engineer and tinker in Ratchet. He seeks Venture Company trade secrets and hires adventurers to disrupt its works and seize its inventions.

faq.q: Where is the control console located?
faq.answer: The control console is inside the Venture Company research site north of the Crossroads and southwest of the polluted Sludge Fen in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is the Venture Company in the Barrens?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a cartel that exploits Kalimdor's natural resources for profit. In the Barrens, its workers clear forests, drill for oil, and build experimental rigs near the Sludge Fen.

faq.q: How do you disengage the samophlange safely?
faq.answer: The console has three open control valves and a keyhole. You use Sputtervalve's retrieved manual to bypass the safety locks and manipulate the valves to detach the module.

faq.q: Does Sputtervalve work for the Venture Company?
faq.answer: No. Sputtervalve works independently of the Venture Company and seeks to steal its engineering discoveries so he can examine them.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see why Sputtervalve covets a rival's designs. Goblins compete fiercely over engineering discoveries.
As a member of the Horde, you have reason to oppose the Venture Company's work. Its exploitation and chemical runoff threaten the Barrens, and its facilities endanger the land you defend.
